Upper Text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Tyrannomon] in name or w/[Dinosaur] trait: Cost 4
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, choose 1 of each player's Digimon with the highest play cost and delete all other Digimon.
[Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is suspended, all of your opponent's Digimon can only attack suspended Digimon.
